## Project format support

`+` means read and write; `~` means one-way or incomplete support.
Hover for limits. Include any referenced media when sharing projects.

| Format | Soundscaper<br>Desktop | FL Studio<br>2026 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Soundscaper (`.sscape`) | + — :: Original media is referenced by default; consolidation bundles it for portability. | / |
| Audacity (`.aup`) | ~ — Import :: Imports the legacy project and its companion media; no AUP export. | / |
| Audacity (`.aup3`) | + — :: Audio-only import/export, with a compatibility report; Soundscaper-only state can be omitted. | / |
| Audacity (`.aup4`) | + — :: Audio-only import/export, with a compatibility report; Soundscaper-only state can be omitted. | / |
| Cool Edit / Audition (`.ses`) | ~ — Import :: Recognized legacy binary layouts only; unsupported state and missing media are reported. No export. | / |
| Audition (`.sesx`) | ~ — Import :: Imports audio tracks, clip placement, trims, simple fades, and static mixer settings. Effects, automation, routing, and other unsupported state are reported; no SESX export. | / |
| Ardour (`.ardour`) | ~ — Import :: Audio edits and editable MIDI from supported modern sessions, clip envelopes, gain/pan/mute/send automation, bus routing, markers, and supported stepped tempo/meter maps. Locates nearby media or requests a folder. Foreign plug-ins retain available state as bypassed placeholders; MIDI uses a replacement instrument. No export. | / |
| REAPER (`.rpp`) | / | / |
| Hindenburg (`.nhsx`) | ~ — Import :: Audio cuts, trims, static levels, mute and fade lengths; locates companion media or requests a folder. Pan and fade curves are converted; ducking, plug-ins, transcripts, markers and Narrator authoring are omitted. No export. | / |
| Pro Tools (`.ptf`) | ~ — Import :: Supported native PTF audio edits, track names, trims, and stereo lanes; locates the Audio Files folder. Legacy PTS is also supported. Mix settings, fades, MIDI, and plug-ins are omitted; no export. | / |
| Pro Tools (`.ptx`) | ~ — Import :: Supported native PTX audio-edit layouts; locates the Audio Files folder. Missing media and unsupported mix settings, fades, MIDI, and plug-ins are reported; no export. | / |
| SoundCraft (`.scraft`, `.scraftz`) | ~ — Import :: Audio edits and editable MIDI from sessions or bundled media, clip envelopes, gain/pan/mute/send automation, buses/sends, folder structure, markers, and tempo metadata. Foreign plug-ins retain available state as bypassed placeholders; MIDI uses a replacement instrument. No export. | / |
| FL Studio (`.flp`, ZIP) | / | + — :: FLP stores project state; a zipped project also collects supported samples and presets. |
| Ableton Live (`.als`) | / | / |
| Bitwig (`.bwproject`) | / | / |
| Logic Pro (`.logicx`) | / | / |
| Cubase (`.cpr`) | / | / |

## Interchange with other tools

| Capability | Soundscaper<br>Desktop | FL Studio<br>2026 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| EDL | + — :: Import and export CMX3600 cuts; export uses one selected sequence track. | / |
| OpenTimelineIO | + — :: Import and export audio/video tracks, gaps, and supported nested stacks. Import also reads referenced MIDI files as editable notes, using a replacement instrument; MIDI export is not supported. | / |
| FCPXML | + — :: Import and export timeline spines, asset clips, and connected lanes. | / |
| DAWproject | + — :: Imports and exports media, MIDI, and supported project structure. Import also converts supported channel/send automation, generic EQ and dynamics, and eligible effect-parameter curves. Foreign plug-in state is preserved in bypassed placeholders; unsupported or converted processing is reported. | / |
| OMF | + — :: Import and export OMF2 audio. Export embeds mono/stereo 24-bit WAV, with a 256 MiB decoded-PCM limit. | / |
| AAF | + — :: Import and export audio cuts and embedded media. Import also recovers editable notes from standard AS-01 auxiliary MIDI attachments, plus gain automation and supported track-pan and dissolve curves. Unsupported operation records are preserved as bypassed placeholders where possible; other processing and picture are reported. | / |
| Round-trip with a video editor | ~ — Framescaper copy :: File-menu handoff creates a separate editable Framescaper copy, with a conversion report | / |
| Blender track export and live sync | + — :: WAV track bundle and one-way edit updates through the bundled Blender 4.2+ add-on | / |
| Labels and markers exchange | + | ~ — WAV markers |
| AES31 ADL | + — Import / export :: AES31-3 audio cuts, source trims, linear fades, and static clip gain with BWF media; unsupported processing, automation, and authoring are reported. | / |

Review omissions in the exchange report.
